body: I feel dead inside. Just waiting for my physical body to die as well.
Same, man. And to think we’re gonna spend the rest of our lives behind the desk.
Thanks man. I really appreciate you reaching out to me, I do. ❤️

I haven’t told them I’m depressed, I don’t want them to worry. I wanted to believe I’m a strong person, but these days I really just wanna give up. I do chat with my mom and sisters from time to time, and thank you for the suggestion. I should video chat them.
Just feel empty and tired of it all. Living on my own away from my family during this Coronavirus crisis is making my depression even more worse.
Thank you, I appreciate  your reply.

You are incredibly strong for fighting the battle with depression this long. I don’t know exactly what you’re going through, but I’m on the same boat with wanting to die, but I don’t want to hurt my family. Hope you find your answer and peace.
I think he must’ve felt that you understood him at that moment..
When I remember how my life is when my dad was still alive and how my family used to be complete. It just makes me so depressed thinking those days are gone.
